Baseline for capture-core: 23 short conversations (34 turns) driven through the PRODUCTION turn path — memoryObserve, addMessage, runPostTurn with default deps, then the real drainJobs — and read back through pic/core.js retrieveKnowledge.

NOTE RESTORED. This file carried the generic 'Baseline for capture-core.' placeholder that `--update` writes when no note exists, which is the one part of a baseline a human writes on purpose. The figures below were not re-measured; only the note was written.

capture_rate 0.8261 and retrievability_rate 0.8947 are SEPARATE and must stay separate — retrievability is computed only over captured cases, so a capture collapse cannot hide behind clean retrieval of the survivors. Two per-category rates sit at 0.5 and are the visible gaps: capture_situation and capture_supersession. capture_concurrency 0.3333 is the lowest number in the file.

A change must not raise capture_rate by lowering retrievability_rate, or vice versa. Regenerate with: npm run eval:gate -- capture-core --update
